question: The mausoleum of the Taj Mahal was designed by _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Ahmad Lahori**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Ahmad Lahori** is credited with being the principal designer of the mausoleum of the Taj Mahal.
 
• The Taj Mahal, an iconic symbol of India, is located in Agra and was commissioned by Emperor **Shah Jahan** in memory of his beloved wife, Mumtaz Mahal.
 
• The construction of the Taj Mahal began in 1632 and was completed in 165
